question: How tall is the site header, and how does it switch to the phone header?

measured.switch: phone header (menu button) up to 816px wide, full menu from 817px

answer: The header lies over the first section, whose padding-top equals the header height. Desktop: title line height (title size value 2 on the heading formula, line height 1.3em) plus 3vw above and below; 4vw side padding, 1.3vw between menu items, 2vw before Login. Phone header: a 40px row plus 6vw above and below. The switch at 817px is not a plain fit of the items; its rule is unknown.
